storylines.summary: One mail carries a new order, a complaint about a past delivery and a visit request; one reply answers all three.
storylines.editorNotes: Several topics in one mail: a sales order, a complaint and a scheduling question.

facts: 1) new order DW-2310: 50 packs drill bits 8.5 mm, delivery 30 July
2) last delivery of hex nuts: 2 boxes M10 instead of M8, please replace
3) MD Pieter Dijkstra wants to visit Hamburg: 10 or 11 September?
beats.subject: Three things
beats.body:
Hi Alex,

three things before my holiday:

1. New order DW-2310: 50 packs HSS-E drill bits 8.5 mm, delivery 30 July.
2. In the last delivery of hex nuts M8 we found 2 boxes with M10 nuts. Please replace them.
3. Our managing director, Pieter Dijkstra, would like to visit you in Hamburg. Would 10 or 11 September work for you?

Thanks!
Femke de Wit
Purchasing
Dijkstra Werktuigen B.V.
+31 40 5550 2301

complaints.title: Dijkstra Werktuigen wrong item hex nuts

tasks.title: 2 Kartons M8-Muttern für Dijkstra Werktuigen ersetzen

questions: Can you replace the 2 boxes of M10 nuts?
Would 10 or 11 September work for a visit?

beats.subject: RE: Three things
beats.body:
Hi Femke,

1. Confirmed as SO-26-0166: 50 packs NH-31020 at 42.60 EUR = 2,130.00 EUR, delivery 30 July.
2. Sorry about the nuts - RMA-26-045; 2 boxes of M8 travel with SO-26-0147.
3. 10 September at 10:00 in our office would be great.

Enjoy your holiday!
Alex

storylines.summary: Export sales asks the managing director about free delivery for a customer, owner in CC; she answers 'ok, machen' and the facts are only in the quote.

facts: Ostrowski fragt nach Lieferung frei Haus ab 1.000 € Bestellwert statt 1.500 € für Q3

Daniel

storylines.summary: The buyer of one customer announces she has moved to another customer and names her successor.
storylines.editorNotes: Same person, new company and address; a new person (successor) with contact details; works_at changes.

facts: since this week purchasing lead at Delacroix Usinage, Grenoble
Julien Marchand is her new colleague
successor at Ateliers Moreau: Lucas Bernard, l.bernard@ateliers-moreau.example
beats.subject: News from Grenoble
beats.body:
Hi Alex,

some news: since this week I work as purchasing lead at Delacroix Usinage in Grenoble - you already know my new colleague Julien Marchand. My successor at Ateliers Moreau is Lucas Bernard (l.bernard@ateliers-moreau.example); he will place the orders from now on.

Looking forward to working with you from here as well!

Camille Rousseau
Purchasing Lead
Delacroix Usinage SAS
+33 4 5550 3902
